description: This file defines functions and types for handling and parsing client error responses in the Superset UI core package, including error object construction, JSON parsing, and error message retrieval.

methods.name: checkForHtml
methods.description: Checks if a string is probably HTML and not JSON.

methods.name: parseStringResponse
methods.description: Parses a string response, translating known error messages or returning 'Unknown error'.

methods.name: getErrorFromStatusCode
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: retrieveErrorMessage
methods.description: Selects the most relevant error message, preferring status code messages over HTML or response text.

methods.name: parseErrorJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON error response into a standardized ClientErrorObject.

methods.name: getClientErrorObject
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a ClientErrorObject from various response types.

methods.name: getErrorText
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message for update failures based on error object and source.

methods.name: getClientErrorMessage
methods.description: Combines a message string with error details from a ClientErrorObject.
